messages:
Ashley: inbound SIG from NovaRetail — they sent a CAIQ and follow-up questions. Need owner for intake. Link to questionnaire: https://files.novaretail.com/caiq-2026.pdf :eyes:
Marta: I'm available, assigning to me for initial review. Quick Q — is this for a POC only or are they asking about production scope (PCI/regulated)?
Ashley: POC first. They mentioned potential Dedicated/private later. Main asks: customer-managed KMS, key rotation cadence, and network isolation. Pricing sensitivity noted. Contact is Linda <linda@novaretail.com>. POC kickoff target: 2 weeks.
Devon: FYI for POC we'll be on hosted API. For Dedicated/Private we can enable customer-managed keys + VPC peering. For now we can provide 'masked data' guidance and exclude PCI data from POC. I'll prep a short POC runbook.
Marta: ok — I'll fill CAIQ for hosted mode and flag the KMS question as "Requires Private" when appropriate. Can you paste the exact KMS question text from their form?
Ashley: here: `Do you support customer-managed keys (CMK/HSM) for encryption of customer data? If yes, describe rotation and control.`
Sam: heads-up — enterprise legal wants DPA + SSO proof before Dedicated discussions. Also need to know whether logs/audit trails are accessible for their SOC team.
Marta: noted. I'll include audit/logs + retention answers. Tentative assignment: Marta will own CAIQ answers; Devon will add POC runbook and hosting notes; Ashley will be primary sales contact to Linda. ETA for draft answers: 48h.
deploy-bot: New security intake ticket created: POC-5891. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/POC-5891
Ashley: pinging for priority — customer says pricing needs to be clarified before next internal sign-off. Any blockers on providing a preliminary pricing range for Dedicated vs Hosted this week?
Devon: I can estimate token / infra costs for the POC on hosted. For Dedicated we'd need sizing first — want a rough QPS and sequence length from them.
Marta: I'll mark the questionnaire priority as high and add a note: "Potential Dedicated; KMS requirement may push to private deployment". If legal or risk escalates, I'll loop in @Grant (security manager).
Ashley: thanks — I'll share POC timeline and ask Linda for QPS and sample sequence lengths now.
Sam: adding quick checklist for thread: 1) CAIQ answers (Marta) 2) POC runbook + hosting notes (Devon) 3) Pricing delta estimates (Devon/Ashley) 4) Legal/DPA check (Sam) 5) Ticket tracking (POC-5891).
Marta: agree. Will post draft CAIQ here when ready. :thumbsup:
